Title: Loop Ghost
Description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.
Instructions:
Buttons & Doors  step on a button to open a linked door. The door stays open only while the button is held
Push Blocks  push blocks onto buttons to hold them. Blocks stay in place between cycles
